title: curie adapter token --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie adapter token`, the ONE result that carries a credential value and the one that declares itself as such. The token goes to stdout and to no diagnostic stream, so a caller can pipe stdout while keeping stderr in a log.

token.description: The minted chn token, scoped to the pair below for ttl_s seconds.

secret.description: Pinned true so a consumer can branch on it: this payload carries a credential value.

kind.description: The channel kind the token is scoped to.

address.description: The concrete address the token is scoped to. The API resolves on the pair, never the address alone.

ttl_s.description: The token lifetime in seconds, between 1 and 604800.
